style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

visibleCriteria.desired: The toque has a continuous band and rounded, readable crown lobes rather than a stepped white box. Curls form a coherent chocolate crown/fringe/occiput with purposeful variation and no bead pile or scalp gaps. Head, sleeves, palms and apron have soft volume and useful silhouette transitions. Side and rear modeling must be equally finished.
visibleCriteria.useSizeGoal: At192x320, viewers can distinguish hat band from crown, major curl groups from face/hat, sleeve/cuff from hand, and apron from coat. Enlarging reveals deliberate construction without pinched lobes, sharp unmotivated steps or melted joins.
visibleCriteria.evidence: Front/back/both side idle plus all state/facing frame sheets; inspect hat/hair silhouette and arm/garment boundaries in maximum work/load poses.

visibleCriteria.desired: Retain dark-brown Lena skin and chocolate hair with clearly different values, warm ivory fabric, blue apron and red scarf. Colors are warm and rich but not overbright, burnt orange, muddy or blacked out. New trim belongs to the same restrained palette.
visibleCriteria.useSizeGoal: The face remains recognizably dark brown; hair remains brown rather than featureless black; the red necktie and blue apron remain distinct where visible through all action frames.
visibleCriteria.evidence: Native frame composites on light,gray,dark backgrounds across every facing; compare original palette cues and fixed target mood without copying its lighter skin drift.

visibleCriteria.desired: Broad soft shading reveals rounded hat folds, curls, cheeks and garment thickness. Ivory retains visible off-white form information instead of broad clipped-white flats; hair and underarms retain form rather than black cavities. Highlights are restrained and stable, with no bright alpha rim, hard specular specks, glare or preferred left/right world light.
visibleCriteria.useSizeGoal: At logical size, hat folds/band and back/side curl groups remain legible without relying on an outline; no rotated facing looks like the unlit side of the character.
visibleCriteria.evidence: Allfour views under one horizontally balanced rig, light/gray/dark composites, action playback to catch shifting highlight artifacts or normals discontinuities.

visibleCriteria.desired: Coat collar, cuff/hem, scarf knot/tails and apron band/pocket read as integrated garment construction. Purposeful folds, edging, buttons or ties may add craft; exact target ornament/part counts are optional. Details follow the rig and remain subordinate to the face and role.
visibleCriteria.useSizeGoal: At192x320, the collar/scarf/apron pocket are clean readable shapes wherever exposed; subpixel stitch noise or dense decorative ridges must not replace major form quality.
visibleCriteria.evidence: Native front/profile/rear closeups plus full-size frames and motion extrema; evaluate hidden-side seams and back apron ties without inventing unseen target requirements.

visibleCriteria.desired: Lena reads immediately as a friendly curly-haired chef with a large expressive face and compact functional body. Eyes, brows and smile stay clear in front/profile as appropriate; no new hat/hair/coat proportions crowd the face, swallow hands or hide necessary action cues.
visibleCriteria.useSizeGoal: At logical size, idle,working,holding and loading remain distinguishable; action hands/knife/dish silhouettes remain readable where physically visible. Natural rear-body occlusion is acceptable only when source-consistent and functional contact evidence passes, not an excuse for new clipping or disappearance.
visibleCriteria.evidence: Full-frame192x320 playback and state comparisons in all4 actual facings, with shared scale and ground root.

visibleCriteria.desired: No black patches, chalky white slabs, pinholes, coplanar flicker, bad normals, detached ends, hair/hat gaps, intersections, crawling seams, stray opaque pixels or contaminated alpha fringe. No unwanted ground shadow. Silhouette antialiasing stays clean against light,gray,dark.
visibleCriteria.useSizeGoal: No defect that catches the eye at logical size; enlarged views distinguish intentional soft valleys from occlusion glitches. No material unfinished patch in rear,inner arms,under hat or apron/body overlaps.
visibleCriteria.evidence: All192 actual frames through verified frame sheets, every state/facing playback and representative/background-edge views; enlarge any suspect region.

visibleCriteria.desired: Soft construction remains stable through motion: hat/curls stay attached to head, collar/apron follow the torso without tearing, palms and utensil retain intended grip, held dish follows evaluated hands with correct depth, and load reaches the belt contact without floating or penetrating geometry. Foot/root contacts remain planted according to source behavior.
visibleCriteria.useSizeGoal: No visible jitter, mesh pop, shading flicker, hidden hand regression, collision or discontinuous looping at12fps. Load ends in the correct placement state without accidental loop closure.

qualityCriteria.approvalRule: No numeric score threshold. Approve only the exact hash-bound candidate after material visible improvement toward these frozen outcomes, complete192frame evidence, passing technical/contact contract and no material dead spot in required views. Missing evidence yields needs_evidence; useful authorized geometry differences alone are not blockers.
